newsitem.title: USA: Donnkenny buys Fashion Avenue Knitwear.
newsitem.headline: Donnkenny buys Fashion Avenue Knitwear.

text.p: Donnkenny Inc said Monday it had bought Fashion Avenue Knitwear and expected the acquisition to add about $40 million in annual sales volume during the 1997 fiscal year.
Donnkenny did not reveal the terms of the purchase and its officials were unavailable for comment.
It said it expected the immediate effect of the deal on its financial performance would be "relatively neutral for the balance of fiscal 1996 and be accretive to (its) earnings in fiscal 1997".
Based in Ridgewood, New York, Fashion Avenue makes knits and sweaters that are distributed in department stores.
